##2.seurat obj
```{r}

# ── 2. Collect into a list ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
data_list <- list(m1, m2, m3, m4, m5, m6, m7, m8, m9)

# ── 3. Processing function ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
process_matrix <- function(mat, sample_name, expected_cells = 5000) {
  
  # Handle multimodal data (e.g., GEX + ADT); keep Gene Expression only
  if (is.list(mat)) mat <- mat[["Gene Expression"]]
  
  # Identify real cells using defaultDrops
  em   <- defaultDrops(mat, expected = expected_cells)
  keep <- which(em)
  
  # Safety check
  if (length(keep) == 0)
    stop(paste("No cells retained for sample:", sample_name))
  
  # Subset to real cells
  mat_filtered <- mat[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Create Seurat object
  Obj <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts       = mat_filtered,
    project      = "Lymph Node",
    min.cells    = 3,    # keep genes detected in ≥3 cells
    min.features = 200   # keep cells with ≥200 detected genes
  )
  
  # Track sample origin
  Obj$sample <- sample_name
  
  return(Obj)
}

# ── 4. Process all samples ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
obj_list <- lapply(
  seq_along(data_list),
  function(i) process_matrix(data_list[[i]],
                              sample_name    = paste0("Obj", i),
                              expected_cells = 5000)
)
names(obj_list) <- paste0("Obj", seq_along(obj_list))

# ── 5. Merge all Seurat objects ───────────────────────────────────────────────
Obj <- merge(
  x            = obj_list[[1]],
  y            = obj_list[2:length(obj_list)],
  add.cell.ids = paste0("obj", seq_along(obj_list)),
  project      = "Lymph Node"
)


```

##4 normalize
```{r}
#Normalize,fvf,pca,scale
Obj=NormalizeData(Obj, verbose = FALSE)
Obj=FindVariableFeatures(Obj)
Obj=ScaleData(Obj, vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),features = VariableFeatures(object = Obj))
Obj=RunPCA(Obj,features = VariableFeatures(object = Obj))
ElbowPlot(Obj,ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")



```



##5integration
```{r}


##integration
library(harmony)
Obj =RunHarmony(Obj,group.by.vars = "sample",orig.reduction = "pca",dims.use = 1:30  )
Obj[["RNA"]]=JoinLayers(Obj[["RNA"]])
Obj = RunUMAP(Obj, reduction = "harmony", dims= 1:30, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")
DimPlot(Obj,reduction = "umap.harmony",group.by = c("sample"),label.size = 2, shuffle = T)


#for the resolution
Obj=FindNeighbors(Obj,dims = 1:30)
for (res in seq(0.2, 1, by = 0.1)) {
  Obj <- FindClusters(Obj, resolution = res)
  colname <- paste0("res_", res)
  Obj[[colname]] <- Obj$seurat_clusters
}
res_cols <- grep("^res_", colnames(Obj@meta.data), value = TRUE)
for (res in res_cols) {
  p <- DimPlot(Obj, group.by = res, label = TRUE, reduction = "umap.harmony") +
       ggtitle(paste("Resolution:", res))
  print(p)
  readline(prompt="Press [Enter] to see the next resolution...")
}

#save 
p_res04=DimPlot(Obj,group.by = "res_0.4",label = TRUE,reduction = "umap.harmony" ) + ggtitle("Resolution: 0.4")+
  labs(x = "UMAP.h", 
         y = "UMAP.h")
ggsave(filename = "output/Lymph_node/LN/resolution.png",plot = p_res04,width = 12,height = 8,dpi = 300)



```




###5-clusters and find all markers
```{r}
###clusters

Obj=FindNeighbors(Obj,reduction = "harmony",dims = 1:30)
Obj=FindClusters(Obj, resolution = 0.4,cluster.name = "harmony_clusters")
#markers
Obj_markers=FindAllMarkers(Obj,only.pos = TRUE,min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
Obj_markers = Obj_markers%>% filter(p_val_adj < 0.05, abs(avg_log2FC) > 0.25)



```



###6. annotation
```{r}


library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)

# Get all clusters
clusters <- unique(Obj_markers$cluster)

# List to store top 30 genes per cluster
top_genes_list <- list()

# Loop over clusters
for(clust in clusters){
  top_genes <- Obj_markers %>%
    filter(cluster == clust) %>%
    arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%   # sort by log fold-change
    slice_head(n = 30) %>%          # take top 30
    pull(gene)                      # get gene names
  
  top_genes_list[[paste0("cluster_", clust)]] <- top_genes
}

# Print top 30 per cluster
for(clust in names(top_genes_list)){
  cat("=== ", clust, " ===\n")
  print(top_genes_list[[clust]])
  cat("\n")
}

# Combine into a table for Excel
top_genes_df <- data.frame(
  matrix(
    NA,
    nrow = 30,
    ncol = length(clusters),
    dimnames = list(NULL, paste0("cluster_", clusters))
  )
)

for(i in seq_along(clusters)){
  clust <- clusters[i]
  genes <- top_genes_list[[paste0("cluster_", clust)]]
  top_genes_df[1:length(genes), i] <- genes
}

# Save to Excel
write.xlsx(top_genes_df, "output/Lymph_data/top30_genes_per_cluster.xlsx")


```

```{r}
## 1. Get cluster identities as characters
clusters <- as.character(Idents(Obj))

## 2. Define mapping from cluster number → cell type
cluster_colors <- c(
  "0"  = "Stromal",
  "1"  = "B cells",
  "2"  = "BEC",
  "3"  = "LEC",
  "4"  = "BEC",
  "5"  = "Stromal",
  "6"  = "B cells",
  "7"  = "Cytotoxic T cells",
  "8"  = "Dendritic cells",
  "9"  = "LEC",
  "10" = "BEC",
  "11" = "Stromal",
  "12" =  "Dendritic cells",
  "13" = "LEC",
  "14" = "LEC",
  "15" = "Stromal",
  "16" = "Stromal",
  "17" = "Stromal",
  "18" = "Stromal"
)

## 3. Map cluster numbers to cell types
celltype <- cluster_colors[clusters]

## 4. Assign names to match cell barcodes
names(celltype) <- colnames(Obj)

## 5. Add cell_type metadata
Obj$celltype <- celltype

## 6. Make sure identities are still cluster numbers (0–11)
Idents(Obj) <- "harmony_"



## 7. Plot UMAP
p <- DimPlot(
  Obj,
  reduction = "umap.harmony",
  group.by = "celltype",   # legend uses cell type names
  label = F,             # numbers (0–11) appear on the UMAP
  label.size = 4
) +
  scale_color_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Set3")+
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",                        # legend on top
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(2, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, color="black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8)
  )
p
ggsave(filename = "output/Lymph_data/celltype.png", plot=p, width = 12, height = 8)

```
